title: H4 fix round 1: role_cap reads [limits].max_budget_usd (not [review]) so the per-goal reservation guard actually fires, and a dispatch reservation is released when executor.start holds the task as exhausted; the five acceptance tests at 530c2ab stay green (review T-0390)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain ade6b74 and 530c2ab (T-0362, H4 code and its five acceptance tests) in git log; never drop or amend them. Review T-0390 judged ade6b74 before 530c2ab added the tests; its first finding is answered by 530c2ab (confirm the five tests exist and pass, do not rewrite them). Remaining findings:
1. (high) orchestrator/pool.py:273 role_cap is read from self.cfg["review"]["max_budget_usd"], a key that does not exist; [limits].max_budget_usd is where the role caps live, so role_cap is always None and the per-goal half of the oversubscription guard never triggers. Read [limits].max_budget_usd[role] (falling back to [review].budget_usd for role review if that is the existing review budget key), and make the goal-level refusal path real. Test: tests/test_pool.py::test_goal_role_cap_refuses_when_goal_spend_plus_reservations_exceed_cap (goal spend plus live reservations for the role over the cap refuses; under the cap allows).
2. (med) orchestrator/executor.py:214 when daemon.dispatch reserved under a Claude account in fallback mode and executor.start's _exhausted path holds the task (no fallback tier), the reservation under that run_key is never released until the 900 s lease sweep. Release the reservation on every early-exit path of executor.start (held as exhausted, refused, exception) in a finally, using the same run_key dispatch used. Test: tests/test_executor.py::test_exhausted_hold_releases_dispatch_reservation.
Keep the five T-0362 tests and every existing test green. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
